name: Grey's Anatomy Complete Series 1 to 17 DVD Set
seoTitle: Grey's Anatomy Complete Series DVD Gift
metaDescription: The Grey's Anatomy series 1 to 17 DVD set, a big binge worthy gift for nurses and nursing students who love to yell at medical TV on their days off.
summary: Seventeen seasons of Grey's Anatomy on DVD is a splurge gift for the nurse who loves medical drama, or loves picking apart everything the show gets wrong.
bestFor: Nurses who binge on days off
whyItWorks: Plenty of nurses swear they hate medical shows, then quietly rewatch Grey's Anatomy on their days off. Part of the fun is yelling at the screen when the surgeons start doing every nurse's job. A complete set lets them do that without hunting for which streaming service has it this month.

Physical discs have a real appeal for night shift workers who sleep at odd hours and want something comforting playing in the background. A box set is also a great group watch gift for nursing school friends who first bonded over the show and are now working on actual units. It suits a graduation or a big holiday gift for a longtime fan, and it can become a tradition on post shift recovery days. Add a bag of popcorn and a cozy blanket and you have a full day off plan wrapped up in one package.
goodToKnow: The set is DVD, so make sure the recipient still has a DVD or Blu ray player.
It covers seasons 1 through 17, so later seasons are not included.
Check the listing for region and format details if you are shipping outside the US.

faq.q: Do nurses actually like Grey's Anatomy?
faq.a: Many do, often as a guilty pleasure. Even nurses who find it unrealistic tend to enjoy pointing out the mistakes.

faq.q: Is this a good graduation gift?
faq.a: For a fan, yes. It is a fun reward after years of studying, and many nursing students grew up watching the show.
